snippet.title: Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World - Official Console Announcement Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Console Announcement Gameplay Trailer for Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World, a 2D sci-fi gothic Metroidvania developed by Vertex Zero. Players will fight through a sprawling underground facility to retrieve the mysterious Angel’s Egg in the year 2997. Make sense of a long-gone civilization in Silent Planet - Elegy of a Dying World, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming
